annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Guidelines: Draft National Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Guidelines: Draft National Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication and Information Technology (MCIT), Qatar
annotation.summary_en: Qatar's MCIT consultation guidelines (bilingual Arabic/English) for the Draft National AI Policy, which is an umbrella policy built on five pillars: digital infrastructure, data, human capabilities, institutional capacity and AI governance. The document sets out consultation questions and procedures; the draft policy text itself is a separate attachment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft National AI Policy serves as umbrella for coherence across Qatar's AI efforts
Five pillars: Digital Infrastructure, Data and Information, Human Capabilities, Institutional Capacity, AI Governance
Stakeholders invited to respond by email using a prescribed template
Draft is not final or binding; MCIT not obliged to adopt comments
Responses may be published; respondents waive copyright
